headline: US Treasury and IRS Finalize Rules for Automatic Retirement Plan Enrollment
summary: The US Treasury and IRS published final regulations under the SECURE 2.0 Act, offering employers guidance to expand automatic enrollment in workplace retirement savings plans.
why: The SECURE 2.0 Act reshapes US retirement plan administration, boosting long-term retail asset inflows into pension and mutual funds.

impacts.name: US Asset Management
impacts.why: Automatic workplace enrollment rules steadily expand corporate 401(k) inflows and asset manager AUM.
